Package com.rpglab.game.battle.moves

Class TailSwipe

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.rpglab.game.battle.moves.TailSwipe
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    CombatAction
    public class TailSwipe
extends java.lang.Object
implements CombatAction
    A powerful tail-based sweeping attack used by reptilian and draconic monsters. This combat action utilizes a creature's tail as a weapon to deliver a wide-area strike that can knock enemies off balance while dealing damage.

    This move is commonly used by dragons, lizardmen, and other creatures with muscular tails, representing a signature attack that leverages their natural anatomy as a weapon.

      • execute

        public void execute​(Combatente user,
                    Combatente target)
        Executes the tail swipe attack on the specified target. The attack deals 25 points of bludgeoning damage, representing a powerful sweeping strike using a muscular tail as a natural weapon.
        Specified by:
        execute in interface CombatAction
        Parameters:
        user - the combatant performing the tail swipe (typically reptilian creatures)
        target - the combatant receiving the bludgeoning damage
